brief:
Officials in Gaza announced plans to evacuate residents from war-damaged structures following the collapse of an apartment block last week that killed multiple people. The evacuation effort faces severe obstacles, including insufficient resources and limited coordination capacity across the territory.

Widespread structural damage across Gaza stems from ongoing conflict. Authorities have not yet detailed timelines or locations for the evacuation operations, al-Monitor reported.

title: Gaza races to evacuate residents from crumbling war-damaged buildings
